quest_template.Title: Ar'lia of the Moro'gai
quest_template.Details: My tribe sees me in high regard, have we not lived humble but resplendent lives up until just a few moons ago. Now the Moro'gai are sundered, torn apart, leaving us weak and isolated on this island. All the while our fallen brethren are wreaking havoc across the coast, jeapordizing the bonds we had formed with the other inhabitants of this land.$B$BApologies, Parash'ka. Here you stand before me, with a mission on your own, yet all that leaves my heart are laments of my own; no words of wisdom as befit for a chieftain. The hostile draenei you encountered so far are the Fallen Ones, heretic followers of my most trusted advisor - and dearest friend - Elder Bhu'robi. We've been under relentless attacks for quite a while now, their aggression increasing with each passing day. In light of our dire situation, my son Ar'lia volunteered to resolve this crisis. Speak to him and learn what he has uncovered so far. You'll find him outside on the marketplace.
quest_template.Objectives: Speak with Ar'lia in Moro'gai Village in Moonwhisper Coast.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: Father sent you? How unlikely of him to relegate a foreigner to me, but truth be told he hasn't been exactly himself lately. The betrayal is deeply seated, the Elder was a well-loved figure within the tribe, second only to my father. Which is exactly what makes his actions all the more despicable.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Welcome to Moro'gai Village, how can I aid you?

quest_template.Title: Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
quest_template.Details: We have watched the Fallen Ones' movement closely ever since they had locked us up in our village. While some roam the outskirts along Shimmerstar Lake, the majority of their forces assault us from the north. Sadly, their aggressions are not limited to us. They've begun ambushing the local Tauren and even raided one of their villages, as you may know already. This begs the question: Just what is their goal?$B$BWhat we need first is information. Nar'lan, one of our hunters and close friend of mine, volunteered in infiltrating the outpost they erected, east of Riverhorn Village. Acting as a defector of our tribe, he already reported valuable details back to us. His last report spoke of him pursuing a dangerous lead, and we haven't heard of him since. In my mind I accepted the possible outcome, yet my heart yearns for it to be false. Venture to the Fallen Ones' outpost and search for Nar'lan. And if necessary, finish what he started.
quest_template.Objectives: Find Nar'an in the outpost north of Moro'gai Village and report back to Ar'lia in Moro'gai Village.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: How barbaric. Tooru, how could you?! He was an aspiring hunter, his heart full of noble aspirations. To Nar'lan, he was like a younger brother…$B$BI had thought after escaping from our dying homeworld, we'd be safe from dangers, atleast for a while. How naive of me, you might say, and you may even be right. Nar'lan knew the risks he'd had to face, as he told me the night he left the village. His resolve was admirable. Today, the Moro'gai have lost a great hunter and an even greater friend.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: We don't know their motives, and from what Father had told me about their reasons, something isn't adding up. If they were simply discontent with our way of living, they would not resort to such violence.

quest_template.Title: An Ill Omen
quest_template.Details: So this is the crystal you have found on Nar'lan? The item that he paid with his life for? Its surface is crude and surprisingly hot, almost scalding. Even so, there is an air of familiarity about it… Could it be that…?$B$B$N, I have a suspicion on what this crystal might be, but we need confirmation. Please talk to my mentor Riftmaster Ral'pekta outside the chieftain's hut. A man as knowledgeable as him can shine light upon this mystery.
quest_template.Objectives: Deliver the red crystal to Riftmaster Ral'pekta in Moro'gai Village.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: This is sacrilegious! What have they done to this crystal?!
quest_template.RequestItemsText: What is it, Parash'ka? Don't waste my precious time with your infantile curiosity.

quest_template.Title: Draenei Divination
quest_template.Details: The mere thought of some… some creature meddling with our sacred draenethyst…! Preposterous, this act cannot go unpunished. Bhu'robi and his Fallen Ones have broken our hallowed traditions and must be held responsible for it. We will find the crystal's foul origin and rid them of this world. Through the art of divination I shall locate from whence it came, but for that I need your assistance. I require specific ingredients and you will bring them to me.$B$BBring me everything noted on this scroll and the truth will soon be revealed.
quest_template.Objectives: Acquire the needed materials and bring them to Riftmaster Ral'pekta in Moro'gai Village.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: These will suffice, you have proven your usefulness even as a Parash'ka. The chieftain's trust in you is more than peculiar, yet I trust his decision nonetheless. Now then, let us uncover what dark magic was cast upon this crystal.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Make haste, young fool. The solution to this enigma cannot be postponed.

quest_template.Title: Hooves and Horns, Clad in Red
quest_template.Details: <Ral'pekta has a stern expression on his face, a bead of sweat runs down his wrinkled olive skin.>$B$BI have peered through the Nether and seen the root of the red crystal. As I focused on the divination, dreadful images rushed past my mind. Tall creatures with hooves and sharp claws walking a bloodred canyon, among them draenei, carrying our sacred draenethyst. These hooved fiends… Their horns and fur remind me of the demons of the Twisting Nether, horrors which have enthralled the orcs years ago on Draenor. Parash'ka, venture north, past Riverhorn Village. There, beyond the mountain range you should find what I have gazed at. Whatever you will find there will not be friendly.$B$BYoung Ar'lia was correct in sending you to me. He took the teachings of his father to heart, even if he himself can't see it. As his tutor, I know he still has much to learn. Once you have found the perpetrators of this heresy, bring proof of their demise to Ar'lia. He should await you on the marketplace.
quest_template.Objectives: Search for the draenei conspirators and bring proof of their death to Ar'lia in Moro'gai village.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: The Fallen Ones were enslaved… no, they cooperated with the horned fiends you call Satyr? Unbelievable, after all that happened to our people on Draenor, how could Bhu'robi spit on our traditions like that? The elder I know would've never let the Draenethyst be defiled by foreign sorcerers. And if what is written in this letter is true… then my Father knows more than he dares to admit.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: You've been gone for a long time. What could Master Ral'pekta uncover?

quest_template.Title: Proof of Conviction
quest_template.Details: You stand before Narkogg the Dark, speaker of the remaining Timbermaw of Ursolan. My brethren and I are splintered and on the brink of extinction. Darkness has befallen Timbermaw Hold and we are powerless in front of the wave of corruption seeping out of its gates. If we ever wish to rid it off its muck, then allies are what we desperately need. Will you and your kind be the ones to aid us in our endeavour? For that I need proof.$B$BEnter the tunnels of our old home and break through the gateway. Slay Karrsh the Sentinel; once a proud defender, now a maddened savage seeking nothing but blood. His rampage needs to be stopped.
quest_template.Objectives: Present Narkogg the Dark in the Maw of Ursoc in Azshara with proof of slaying Karrsh the Sentinel in Timbermaw Hold.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: You have returned, with Karrsh’s pendant. His death is regrettable and saddens me deeply. To see a beacon of resilience and strength rot away in such a short amount of time is terrible. Thank you for releasing him of his pain.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: It may not have been long since we escaped Timbermaw Hold, but the horrors inside evolve with rapid speed. Who knows what abhorrent creatures you will face inside?

quest_template.Title: The Corruption of Timbermaw Hold
quest_template.Details: Our vigil over the Wilds was always ancient, but ever since the second invasion of the Burning Legion, a foul sickness has been germinating within our most hallowed sanctum. Our tribesmen succumbed to the vile influence, one after another. Now only we remain and it falls to us to liberate Timbermaw Hold from the clutches of evil. Before we can cleanse our home for good, we first need to understand what we are dealing with. Studying it inside the caverns is far too dangerous, so we need a substitute instead.$B$BReturn to Timbermaw Hold and gather the totems of the misguided shaman, with them we can find a way to battle the ailment plaguing my people.
quest_template.Objectives: Collect Withermaw Totems from Withermaw Shaman inside Timbermaw Hold and bring them to Narkogg the Dark in the Maw of Ursoc in Azshara.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: These totems are worse than I expected. The fumes they release are unbearable and simply touching them leaves burning marks upon my paws. I will have to seal them away before we can deal with them properly.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Unforeseen strength gathered within the Withermaw; their newfound power being too much for their bodies, causing them to tear apart.

quest_template.Title: Ancient Furbolg Remedies
quest_template.Details: Over the millennia that we have lived on Kalimdor, my people developed countless concoctions and salves for medicinal and spiritual healing. However, to cleanse these wicked totems, a wholly new mixture has to be created.$B$BIn the lands blessed by the wilds, the place your kind calls Un’goro Crater, a beast by the name of Rotvine, laden with natural energies and powerful dew, resides. Rumor has it the river’s end in the northwest is its home. Bring me its dewladen heart.$B$BOn the southern shores of the Isle of Dread in Feralas you will find a primordial being, a sea giant from olden times. He held watch over the tides of the Veiled Sea, but has reached a point where his mind can’t discern between friend or foe anymore. Lay him to rest and deliver me his tongue.$B$BThe Vials of Purification lay with Tidelord Rrurgaz. Once a relic of the night elves on ancient  Kalimdor, it fell into the hands of the Shahraz naga who scheme on Alcaz Island, northeast of the shores of Dustwallow Marsh.
quest_template.Objectives: Narkogg the Dark in the Maw of Ursoc in Azshara requires specific materials for the purification salve. Bring them to him.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: I am in awe at the power of these items. With the beast’s heart, we will break the foul barrier around the totems. Grammon’s tongue will let them speak true and the waters of purification will wash away all impurities.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: My seal will not hold for long, $N. Please hasten your efforts.

quest_template.Title: Unbridled Darkness
quest_template.Details: It seems I underestimated the Withermaw. Whatever has taken hold in these totems is not only of demonic origin. I fear what we have is not enough to break the curse put on them.$B$B$N, if we want to succeed, we need to venture into Timbermaw Hold once more. Deep within Timbermaw Village, the Grotto of Dreams lies. Formerly used by our spiritualists for communion with the Emerald Dream, it now houses a sinister miasma. When we fled our old home, I abandonded my medicine pouch there. I need the implement found within to conjure a more fitting spell. Furthermore, a sample of the defilement found within Timbermaw Hold. Mixed into the salve, it will act as an antidote to the malediction inside the totems, if you will. Certainly you will find such a sample inside the many crevices found along the waterways inside.
quest_template.Objectives: Retrieve Narkogg’s Medicine Pouch and the Putrid Flower from within Timbermaw Hold for Narkogg the Dark in the Maw of Ursoc in Azshara.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: What a hideous creation. Further proof that the life inside our great sanctum is rotting by the minute. Yet still, it serves a purpose. It shall pave the way for the Timbermaw to reclaim what has been torn from us by cruel malefactors. Now I can concoct a salve powerful enough to cleanse our sacred totems.$B$B$N, this humble coven expresses its gratitude towards you. Through your courage, we have made the first step in purifying Timbermaw Hold. Take this essence and use it on your delves into this den of evil. With enough of it, you may break the barrier inside and finally come to the root of it all.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Timbermaw Village will be heavily guarded. Be best prepared, for the Withermaw have abandoned all morality.

quest_template.Title: What Remains
quest_template.Details: $N, your loyalty and determination to our cause knows no bounds. With remarkable bravery have you faced the twisted Withermaw and stopped their machinations. The strength and willpower you and your allies displayed is exactly why it is you that I will ask of the impossible.$B$BAs I explained to you before, Timbermaw Hold is a sacred site for all Furbolgs. It is where we venerate the remains of the Wild God Ursol, which we have guarded for millenia since his fall at the hands of the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancient. I was not present at his resting place when the Withermaw took over, yet I fear the body of the ancient guardian fell victim to the corruption.$B$BCourageous ally of ours, please return to Timbermaw Hold and see what has become of our great god. Should the foulness have taken control of his carcass, then… Gather your might and let him return to the Emerald Dream once more.
quest_template.Objectives: Slay Ursol in Timbermaw Hold. Report to Narkogg the Dark in the Maw of Ursoc in Azshara afterwards.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: In our ancient teachings, there is a legend that connects all furbolg tribes. It speaks of our creation, as it is said the twin gods have brought us into the world as it was still young. As juvenile cubs they frolicked through the untouched wilds of Kalimdor, rolling around in the dewladen grass of the early mornings. Laughter filled the air and their unbound energy floated all around them. Bursting with their power, the droplets of the wet grass fell onto the roots of gigantic trees, seeping through the bark and becoming one with the land. Over time, these droplets grew and took the semblance of the young ursine gods.$B$BTo us furbolgs there is nothing more important than aiding our progenitors in protecting the wild. Seeing Ursol die for a second time fills my heart with anguish and pain, a being as noble as him did not deserve this fate. $N, the Timbermaw are forever in your debt. Please take this powerful salve and cleanse the remaining corruption in Timbermaw Hold.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: <Narkogg is stuck in a praying position. Through the rough whispers of his maw you can deduce him singing a ritualistic song.>

quest_template.Title: Nightmare’s End
quest_template.Details: The demigod Ursol has been slain, the pendant in your hand acting as proof of your and your allies’ deed. Curious enough, there seems to be no trace of the Nightmare’s influence on the pristine jade stone you’ve found on the wild god’s body.$B$BLosing yourself in the stone’s hum, you see a bear’s silhouette in the woods of the tranquil Moonglade before you.
quest_template.Objectives: Deliver the Pendant of Dreams to the Great Bear Spirit in Moonglade.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: <Presenting the honorable spirit with the pendant, a shiver of awe travels down your spine. Silence falls over Moonglade and your surroundings dim as your focus on the ursine figure before you grows stronger. In that moment, a familiar voice rings inside your head:$B$BThank you for saving my brother. The elders of the wild offer you this in return.$B$BAt the paws of the great spirit lay trinkets, presumingly the reward for releasing Ursol from his pain. Choose wisely.>
quest_template.RequestItemsText: <The great spirit looks at you with a venerable gaze.>

quest_template.Title: Parcel to Nowhere
quest_template.Details: The crate you’ve found on the satyr is heavy and resonates with a droning noise. Opening the lid exposes numerous of the dark red crystals you’ve seen around the grotto, tainted draenethyst shards filled with an unsettling energy. Riftmaster Ral’pekta should see this.
quest_template.Objectives: Return to Riftmaster Ral’pekta in Moro’gai Village with the crystal crate from Foulheart Sanctum.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: More of those despicable crystals. I feel such anger inside me laying eyes upon this defilement of our sacred draenethyst. Tainted, broken and sullied. Whatever they’ve done with it is unforgivable!
quest_template.RequestItemsText: You are back, did you find something in that red canyon?

quest_template.Title: Merchant’s Knowledge
quest_template.Details: Excuse my outburst. I’ve tended to the crystals throughout all of my five hundred and twenty-seven years, my connection to them is deeper than most draenei out there. Nevertheless, there is a most peculiar thing about these crystals. They are packed inside a crate, a situation that appears strange given the fact the tained draenethyst was all around the demonic fiends inside that canyon. Which leads me to believe that these crystals were destined to be delivered somewhere.$B$BHere, take the crate and talk to Maghan, our resident merchant. I am sure he will know more about the crate. He traveled south of the village, just follow along the road and I am sure you will find him eventually.
quest_template.Objectives: Talk with Maghan the merchant south of Moro’gai Village about the crystal crate.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: It is true that I know a bit more about these crates, but it has been quite some time since I last saw them in person.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: It is not safe out here. If you’re not familiar with these woods, I suggest you seek shelter at our village to the north.

quest_template.Title: Out of the Moonlight
quest_template.Details: The crates belong to the bearfolk just across the road, the way the wood of the crate is bent is typical for them. When we were still actively trading I inspected the crates regularly, so I am sure it has to be theirs. Trade between us may have stopped now, but there is still activity coming from their fortifications over there. Whenever I traverse these roads, I sometimes get a glimpse of a burly bearfolk going further south and towards that cave up the hill. If you want to get to the bottom of this, your best chance would be to see what they’re carrying.
quest_template.Objectives: Pursue the Blackroot Runners and bring their cargo to Riftmaster Ral’pekta in Moro’gai Village.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: So it was the bearfolk who were acting as laymen between the hoofed fiends and the Fallen Ones. You are saying they tried delivering the crystals to the large cave up the hills towards the auburn cliffs? I have heard the network of tunnels beneath the mountain is their sacred hideout. A foreboding prospect.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: If there are more than two parties involved in Bhu’robi’s scheme, then what does that tell us about his allegiances - and moreover, his aspirations?

quest_template.Title: Draenethyst Recovery
quest_template.Details: Whatever the bearfolk intend on accomplishing with the tainted draenethyst, we cannot let it happen. It shall not be misused for nefarious reasons, and as Draenei, it is our duty to ensure it stays that way.$B$B$N, we need your aid once more. Gather brave allies and storm the bearfolk’s sanctuary. Beware: It is very likely for them to conduct sinister rituals with our crystals, from which they mayhaps acquired unforeseen strength. Once you have found the whereabouts of the defiled crystals, punish the perpetrators and return with the remaining draenethyst back to the village. I will prepare a method to cleanse them of their impurities.
quest_template.Objectives: Enter Timbermaw Hold and retrieve the corrupted draenethyst. Bring them to Riftmaster Ral’pekta in Moro’gai Village of Moonwhisper Coast if you are successful.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: The horned fiend; this satyr Selenaxx, you say? He absorbed the energy from the geode and infused his body with it, becoming one with the draenethyst?! To witness such blasphemy even in this new world. $C, the power of draenethyst is deeply alluring and requires immense willpower to not succumb to once tapped into its pulsing energy. There are… stories of Draenei falling victim to their draenethyst addiction and eventually crystalizing, ultimately becoming draenethyst themselves. Thus they return to Draenor and enter the cycle of its lifeblood.$B$BFor now, I will have to prepare the cleansing ritual for the geode shards you brought. It will take time and effort, but I and moreover the Moro’gai are deeply indebted to you. Your continued support to our tribe’s survival shall not go unrewarded. Please choose one of these bracelets, so that they may protect you against the evils yet to come.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: We know little about the bearfolk, they kept to themselves most of the time. For what reason we can only speculate. Was it always their goal to conspire against the Moro’gai? Is the Draenethyst’s power really all they are after?

quest_template.Title: Not Alone
quest_template.Details: Greetings, $C. My name is Nathok of the Timbermaw Tribe. Or atleast what’s left of it. We have been expelled from our ancestral home, Timbermaw Hold, by our fallen brethren, the Withermaw. They befell a terrible darkness, one that crawled throughout northern Kalimdor for an insurmountable time now. Many have succumbed to it already, yet others still continue to fight against it. Long beforehand, the furbolg tribes were in steady communication with one another. However, now they’ve gone silent and we suspect the worst.$B$BWe need to know which tribes are still yet free, and I would appreciate your aid. From the ones we know of, we place the last of our hope on the Winterfall of Winterspring, the Greenpaw of Ashenvale and a small enclave of other Timbermaw furbolgs in the tunnels south of Moonglade. Seek them out and let them know that the Timbermaw still stand as proud defenders of nature.
quest_template.Objectives: Locate the Furbolg tribes of Greenpaw, Winterfall and Timbermaw. Return to Nathok in the Maw of Ursoc in Azshara after finding all three.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: The Greenpaw are beyond salvation? And our brothers’ enclave fights to free the Winterfall tribe from their dark shackles? Time is truy running out. We have to make haste and reconcile with the other Timbermaw as quickly as possible.$B$B$N, thank you for showing us this ray of hope. I will hold a discussion with the others and hopefully send a small envoy to our brothers and sisters up north soon. They shall not be left alone in this everlasting night.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Us Furbolg once roamed the enchanted forests of Kalimdor, tending to the wildlife and flora and maintaining their balance. But since the Legion’s second invasion, almost all of our brethren heed to call of darkness that those demons have left festering on our sacred Land of Stars.

quest_template.Title: The Root of it All
quest_template.Details: We’re working tirelessly on ridding Timbermaw of the corruption, and your efforts are no doubt invaluable, yet still there is little progress in our mission. Instead of removing the dark influence, we are merely halting it spreading further through the hold. There has to be something we are missing, a crucial component we need to address if we want Timbermaw Hold to return to the welcoming home it once was.$B$BThe Timbermaw of the Timbermaw Tunnels between Moonglade, Felwood and Winterspring told us how you were instrumental in eliminating the source of the Winterfall’s corruption, a demon named Xandivious. Let us convide in them and hope they have a clue on what could plague Timbermaw Hold still.
quest_template.Objectives: Speak with Gorn One Eye in the Timbermaw Tunnels south of Moonglade about the persisting darkness inside Timbermaw Hold.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: It has been long, $N. We have heard of your exploits inside Timbermaw Hold and are showing eternal gratitude for the sacrifices you have made for our people. What you accomplished is not a natural given, others would have not shown such compassion to a race that isnt their own. Now tell me, what brings you to me?

quest_template.Title: Emerald Aid
quest_template.Details: Our brothers of Ursolan shared their findings with us not long ago, creating a holy salve to cleanse the corruption inside Timbermaw Hold is a wise decision. But it is not enough. Hidden deep inside is the true cause for the miasma taking hold over Kalimdor, yet we do not know what exactly it may be. The demon Xandivious was responsible for the Winterfall’s corruption, yet Narkogg described the sensation coming from the corruption as something not entirely demonic. I have a hunch on how we could get closer to the solution to this enigma, but for that, we need help.$B$B$C, consult Ysera’s Dragonflight. Not many of them are friendly to us, but some of them are willing to lend an ear to a mortal in need. Past the Great Sea, in the Swamp of Sorrows, a powerful green dragon has awoken from their Dream and awaits mortals like you and me. Perhaps it is for a different reason, but it very well may be for this purpose. Seek them out and ask them about the Flute of Spirits.
quest_template.Objectives: Search for a cooperative green dragon in the Swamp of Sorrows and ask them about the Flute of Spirit.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: Here you are, as expected. Fate is a force beyond our grasp, and if you try to deny your actions are not defined by fate, then I fear you still have much to learn, mortal.

quest_template.Title: The Flute of Spirits
quest_template.Details: You aim to rid Timbermaw Hold of its darkness, I take it? Your and my interests align more than you’d think. It is in my best interest to have it be cleansed of its corruption and I know that I can be crucial in your quest to uncover the cause of it all. Your furbolg friend was correct in his assumption: I do know about the Flute of Spirits. It is an ancient relic of the Wild God Aessina herself. The Kaldorei have entrusted Ysera’s Dragonflight with the relic at the advent of the War of the Ancients. There it lay for countless millennia, until the traitor Insomnius stole it. He was banished for his transgression, the flute lost forever.$B$BIf you wish to claim it, you have to find Insomnius. Luckily for you, the cunning wretch is hard to kill. He goes by the name of Insom’ni now. His delusions were an insult to our noble task of shepherding this world, yet all he strives towards is ruling it like a false deity. You will find him on the isle north of Gilijim’s Isle.
quest_template.Objectives: Find the green dragon traitor Insomnius. Itharius mentioned he resides now on the island north of Gilijim’s Isle.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: Does Itharius miss me so much? I am almost moved to tears. What has changed that the old fool willingly sents mortals to my lair? Let us hope his mother doesn’t hear of this.$B$B<Insom’ni breaks out into hysterical laughter.>

quest_template.Title: One Good Turn Deserves Another
quest_template.Details: Itharius did not lie. The instrument you seek is lost. Do not panic, mortal. I know where you can find it, but I am not as altruistic as you had hoped for. The information shall be yours, if you are willing to serve me.$B$BWhen the pathetic Hazzuli dared to question my irrefutable right to rule over them, there was one worm of a troll instrumental in their conquest against me. Self proclaimed High Speaker Jam’wahli; his words infested the minds of my minions and rallied them against me. Now the rat has fled Lapidis Isle and hides in the temple city of Zul’Gurub, bowing before another god like the dog that he is. Bring me his tusks and I shall tell you where to find the flute.
quest_template.Objectives: Infiltrate Zul’Gurub and return with High Speaker Jam’wahli’s Tusks to Insom’ni on Kazon Island near Gilijim’s Isle.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: <Laughter echoes through the cave. Like a hyena, Insom’ni cackles at the sight of Jam’wahli’s tusks in an unnatural manner.>$B$BWhat goes around comes around, Jam’wahli. You thought your life would be spared under the false protection of your Blood God, but you miscalculated. Nothing compares to my unrivaled cunning, traitor. This is what awaits all who dare defy my absolute rule.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: The fool shall bleed for his arrogance. I want you to make sure of that.

quest_template.Title: Hidden in Plain Sight
quest_template.Details: That felt invigorating. I am in your debt, $C, and that debt I will repay. In my search for susceptible races to subdue I wandered the vast planes of this world. One of them being the fields of the now barren wasteland Desolace. Regrettably I wasn’t being left to my own devices, as Ysera’s pests followed me whenever they picked up my scent. They were after me in hopes of retrieving the flute. What a futile endeavor of theirs. While escaping my pursuers, I placed the flute inside a magically sealed chest deep within Kaldorei ruins in the southeastern mountains, veiling it in a potent shield, masking it from unworthy eyes.$B$B<As Insom’ni grabs your hand, his own transforms into an emerald claw. With it, he carves a verdant rune into your palm. The pain is excruciating.>$B$BNow go. My patience nears its end. With this rune, you will be able to see and open the chest and retrieve what you have fought for.
quest_template.Objectives: Retrieve the Flute of Spirits and bring it to Gorn One Eye in the Timbermaw Tunnels south of Moonglade.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: The myths were true. Such a powerful relic, thought to be lost in time. With it in my hand, I… I am certain we can discover what evil is behind all this misery befalling my people. $N, thank you for your continued help, but don’t rest yet. We still have much to do.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: I have waited for your timely return. Tell me, has the Green Dragonflight been able to aid you in your quest?

quest_template.Title: Fangorn, Lord of Eternity
quest_template.Details: While you were gone looking for the flute, I did my own research. I convened with Narkogg in the Maw of Ursoc and we devised a plan on how to unfold the corruption’s secrets.$B$BOn the island on which the Kaldorei planted the World Tree Teldrassil, an Ancient of remarkable age has rooted himself into the earth of Azeroth, Fangorn, Lord of Eternity. He stood there for eons on his everlasting watch over nature, even after the Night Elves planted the seed of Teldrassil. Someone as old and wise as him will hopefully be able to tell us what darkness resides within Timbermaw Hold.$B$BTake this sealed totem with you. Awaken the Ancient with the Flute of Spirits and show him the totem. Before you go, there is one thing you should know. An ancient being such as him speaks a language long forgotten. You will surely not understand his words. I suggest you speak to the druids of Moonglade to learn his language.
quest_template.Objectives: Speak to the ancient Fangorn at the coast of Teldrassil. To understand his cryptic speech, inquire with the Druids of Moonglade.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: The conversation ends and Fangorn returns back to his eternal vigil.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: The ancient does not move. Like an immovable object, he just stares into the horizon.

quest_template.Title: Wisdom of Ten Thousand Years
quest_template.OfferRewardText: Good work. Now that everything is gathered, I can extract a blessing from the acorn that will have you understand the words of nature itself. Be wary, however. The spell won’t last forever, so hurry to Fangorn with a steady pace.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Greetings, $N. I see your quest is urgent. Fangorn was an ally of our people during the War of the Ancients, his powerful magic and wisdom were key in securing victory over the highborne traitors. Following the Sundering, he remained dormant on the island of Kalidar until this day, influencing the world around him ever so vigilantly.$B$BThe furbolg was correct, he speaks a long forgotten language. One that even the druids of Moonglade barely speak anymore. Teaching it to you would take years, but I can help you in understanding it, even if for a little while. From the foot of the World Tree, bring me an Acorn of Nordrassil, sap from the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale and five Elixirs of Dream Vision. Bring me these ingredients and you may progress on your quest with my assistance.

quest_template.Title: Buried in Ancient Ruins
quest_template.Details: Fangorn’s words still ring inside your head. The ruined city of Elun’aran on Tyrandas, and the cavern system below its temple. You can feel the conclusion to this journey drawing closer.
quest_template.Objectives: Travel to Moonwhisper Coast and explore the caverns below the Temple of Elunaris on the island of Tyrandas. Return with your findings to Gorn One Eye in the Timbermaw Tunnels south of Moonglade.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: <Gorn trembles at the news you bring him. An angered growl bares his sharp fangs as he tries to compose himself.>$B$BPeroth’arn. Second hand of Xavius, the Satyr Lord. There is no mistaking it. This horn fragment and the Withermaw totems share the same kind of malignant energy. A vile mixture of demonic essences and… an unknown dread. Such a crushing presence, it is incredibly profane to even look at.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Welcome back, $N. Did you have any success with old Fangorn?

quest_template.Title: Purging Flames
quest_template.Details: Do you remember the torch I crafted to expunge the demon Xandivious out of the Winterfall Chieftain’s cave? If we want to draw out that despicable monster Peroth’arn out of hiding, then we will need such a torch again, but immensely more powerful. For that, a purging flame is required.$B$BDeep beneath the earth’s crust lies the Molten Core. Magma rivers and scalding stone fill the caverns, while fiery elementals spread chaos among themselves. In this place, a flame of greatest purity can be found. Only a blaze of that intensity will be enough to ensure our plan is a success.$B$BBring it and twenty logs of Star Wood to me. Both are necessary to create a strong enough torch.
quest_template.Objectives: To craft the cleansing torch, Gorn One Eye in the Timbermaw Tunnels south of Moonglade needs a Purging Flame and Star Woods logs.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: Marvelous! The purest of blazes, a primordial heartbeat resonates within this inconspicuous ball of flame. No evil in this world or any other can hide from its revealing light.$B$B$N, it is time. We will erase the darkness from within Timbermaw Hold once and for all.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Please remain cautious. The Molten Core is a treacherous place, and your allies cannot be prepared enough for the dangers inside.

quest_template.Title: Peroth’arn, Nightmare’s Herald
quest_template.Details: Quickly, there is little time to lose. Take the torch, gather your strongest allies and return to Timbermaw Hold. In the innermost sanctum of our god Ursol, place the illuminating beacon in the middle and ready yourself. This demon possesses power beyond your imagination and you should respect his cruelty and cunning. Obliterate this evil from Azeroth and the Emerald Dream! This world does not belong to a vile monster such as him!
quest_template.Objectives: Enter Timbermaw Hold and destroy Peroth’arn. Return to Narkogg the Dark in the Maw of Ursoc in Azshara after you have cleansed the corruption plagueing Kalimdor!
quest_template.OfferRewardText: <A torn look spreads across Narkogg’s face. At first you cannot discern it properly, but the wailing and sobbing coming from him affirm your suspicion: He is crying.>$B$BAfter all these years of suffering and torment, my people can finally release a sigh of relief. The corruption befalling most of our kind and one of our sacred gods has finally been quelled. All thanks to the valiant efforts of brave protectors like you. My words cannot properly convey the gratitude we have towards you and your kin. You will forever be welcome with the Timbermaw, as the cherished hero of the Furbolg.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: You are back! Tell me, quickly! Were our plans successful? Are my people finally free?

quest_template.Title: Loktanag the Pure
quest_template.Details: Perhaps you have felt it yourself or encountered one of its manifestations already, but there is an infestation running rampant in the woods of Kalimdor. It infects the flora and fauna, rendering them to madness, attacking friend and foe alike. Sinister whispers hush among the spirits of nature, rallying the defenders of balance against said corruption.$B$BOne of them is the noble Loktanag, the living embodiment of growth and adaptivity. They sensed a disturbance within the deep underbelly of Mount Hyjal, inside the sacred halls of Timbermaw Hold. Venturing far into the furbolg’s hallowed home, Loktanag tried to halt the spread of the miasma, yet it appears their power was not enough. Now the spirits mourn their rotting body, oozing toxic sludge and permeating the very corruption they wished to stop.$B$B$N, I ask you to lay Loktanag to rest. A noble creature such as them should return to the cycle once more. Balance must be restored.
quest_template.Objectives: Vanquish Loktanag the Vile inside Timbermaw Hold and return to Muln Earthfury at the Earthen Ring in the Stonetalon Mountains.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: A harrowed deed has been done. Loktanag’s body will decompose, become one with the earth again. I know what you have done lies heavy on our hearts, but it was necessary. With time, they will emerge again and foster the growth of nature once more.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: I cannot tell what lies before you on your journey inside Timbermaw Hold. The spirits do not dare speak of that place and deny me any wisdom.

quest_template.Title: Essence of Purification
quest_template.OfferRewardText: It is done. While not as powerful as the original, this essence should be potent enough to douse the braziers spreading the Withermaw’s corruption throughout our sacred tunnels. If you require more, you know where to find me, brave adventurer.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: $N, I have heard of your continued assault on the darkness dwelling within Timbermaw Hold. It seems the salve I had created for you was not enough to quell the miasma. But fret not, as I am able to recreate the salve with a few ingredients. Bring them to me, and we shall resume our fight against evil.

quest_template.Title: Hide of a Wild God
quest_template.Details: The fetid hide of Ursol is all you could rescue of the fallen god’s carcass. Torn and ridden with maggots, you decide to bring it to the furbolg of Ursolan, so that they may cleanse the only remains of their progenitor god.
quest_template.Objectives: Bring the Hide of Ursol to the furbolg of the Maw of Ursoc in Azshara.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: For your acts for furbolgkind, you shall be rewarded honorably: A piece of armor to your liking handcrafted with the cleansed hide, so that you may walk the wilds under Ursol’s blessing, continuing his legacy in fighting for the world he loved so much. Your presence here will remain welcoming in our retreat, as long as you remain true to our cause. Tread safely, $N.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Is this what they have done to our great god? Rotted him from the inside out, defiling his magnificent pelt and body? I dare not think about the agony he must’ve endured during his torment. A relief to hear you have dealt with the traitors and have punished them justly.$B$BThe pelt of Ursol may be tainted, but with the purification salve Narkogg is brewing, we can cleanse it from the impurities. Bring it to me, and it shall be done.

quest_template.Title: Guile of Nature
quest_template.Details: For many years have we furbolgs revered the gods of nature, with the Twin Gods Ursol and Ursoc at the center of our worship. To honor their sacrifices to our world, the greatest shaman of our tribe wore a spiritual garment, spirited armor said to be in tune with the Wild Gods. Now they’re lost in the tunnels of Timbermaw, either in possession of the Withermaw or their corrupted fiends.$B$BThe ritualistic headdress grants a link to the wisdom of the natural spirits, enlightening those wearing it to make the right decisions to the betterment of all. Bring me the headdress and some materials, and I will fashion it anew so that it may aid you in your quest to liberate Timbermaw Hold.
quest_template.Objectives: Bring Kathor the Brave a ritualistic headdress from within Timbermaw Hold as well as a myriad of materials.
quest_template.OfferRewardText: There you have it, friend. Can you feel the spiritual energy coursing through? Those inexperienced will tremble at its might. So please, make good use of it against the foes of darkness.
quest_template.RequestItemsText: Your contributions will be rewarded tenfold.
